full.description: This image shows a gross specimen of lung tissue sectioned to reveal the internal parenchyma and bronchi. The lung tissue exhibits severe dark red discoloration and engorgement, consistent with pronounced congestion. The cut surfaces appear heavy and wet due to the accumulation of blood and fluid within the alveolar spaces. This appearance is characteristic of acute pulmonary congestion.
